title: fix(components): action:menu, action:group and action:icon render no text for a non-string label instead of crashing
body:
Fixes #37266
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：页面上的菜单、按钮组、图标按钮三种操作控件，名称若被写成多语言对象，以前菜单和按钮组会整块报错、图标按钮会崩溃或显示乱码；现在控件照常显示、照常可点，只是不显示那段名称（菜单仍叫“更多操作”，按钮组下拉仍叫“Actions”，图标按钮显示问号）。字符串名称和翻译与以前完全一样。
- 为什么做：沿用上一张卡给普通操作按钮加的同一层显示保护，补齐它的三个兄弟控件，属于“操作按钮名称必须是字符串”这一修复的收尾，按维护者「保持走翻译包」的裁决执行，不改协议、不翻译多语言对象。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是这三种控件上某个名称不显示，页面其余部分不受影响；改动可以直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/`:

- New `renderable-label.ts`: the `renderableLabel` guard moved out of `action-button.tsx` unchanged in behaviour. It gains a `componentType` parameter (default `action:button`, so the button's warning text is byte-identical) and keys its warn-once memo on `componentType:componentKey`. `withRenderableLabel(subject, key, type)` returns the same object when the label is a string or absent, otherwise a copy with `label: undefined`. It is one guard, reused, not forked.
- `action-button.tsx`: imports the guard; no other change.
- `action-menu.tsx`, `action-group.tsx`, `action-icon.tsx`: each renderer guards its own `schema` once at entry (`withRenderableLabel`, keyed on the component id `data-obj-id`), and `action:menu` / `action:group` guard each member where `actions` is built (keyed on the member `name`, else `COMPONENT_ID#INDEX`). Every later read then sees a guarded label. The value is never translated (ruling A, 7118756694).
- `static-params.ts`: the node-level-params warning names a nameless action through `renderableLabel` (scope note 7163349912).

Ruling: option A on #36717 (7118756694), inherited, verbatim: "The renderer must never throw on a non-string label: render no text (or the component id) and log a development warning; it must NOT translate the map (that would accept a value the contract refuses)." `packages/spec` is untouched.

### Every label read and its disposition

The seat's re-check, `git grep -n "schema.label\|action.label" -- ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/`, on `origin/main` d88c41e51: 26 non-test hits.

| File | Read | Disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|
| action-button.tsx | `renderableLabel(schema.label, …)`, `label === schema.label` | already guarded (PR #37262); now imports the shared guard |
| action-group.tsx | `useMemberVisible` diagnostic `action.label` | guarded: members built through `withRenderableLabel` |
| action-group.tsx | inline leaf icon spacing `action.label && 'mr-2'` | guarded (member) |
| action-group.tsx | inline leaf text `{action.label}` | guarded (member); renders no text |
| action-group.tsx | dropdown leaf `action.label \|\| action.name` | guarded (member); shows `name` |
| action-group.tsx | group `visible` diagnostic `schema.label` | guarded: group schema through `withRenderableLabel` |
| action-group.tsx | runner `label: action.label` | guarded (member); runner gets none |
| action-group.tsx | dropdown trigger `schema.label \|\| 'Actions'` | guarded (group); shows `Actions` |
| action-icon.tsx | `visible` diagnostic `schema.label` | guarded: icon schema through `withRenderableLabel` |
| action-icon.tsx | runner `label: schema.label` | guarded; runner gets none |
| action-icon.tsx | `aria-label={schema.label \|\| schema.name}` | guarded; named by `name` |
| action-icon.tsx | `schema.label?.charAt(0) \|\| '?'` | guarded; shows `?` (threw on main) |
| action-icon.tsx | disabled-reason heading `schema.label \|\| schema.description` | guarded |
| action-icon.tsx | tooltip gate and text `schema.label \|\| schema.description` (two hits) | guarded |
| action-icon.tsx | `useAutoTriggerOnce(schema, …)`, `readStaticParamValues(schema, …)` (not grep hits) | read the guarded schema |
| action-menu.tsx | `useMenuActionVisible` diagnostic `action.label` | guarded: members built through `withRenderableLabel` |
| action-menu.tsx | item `action.label \|\| action.name` | guarded (member); shows `name` (threw on main) |
| action-menu.tsx | menu `visible` diagnostic `schema.label` | guarded: menu schema through `withRenderableLabel` |
| action-menu.tsx | runner `label: action.label` | guarded (member); runner gets none |
| action-menu.tsx | trigger `aria-label={schema.label \|\| moreActionsLabel}` | guarded (menu); keeps `More actions` |
| action-menu.tsx | trigger icon spacing and `{schema.label && ...}` (two hits) | guarded (menu); renders no text (threw on main) |
| action-menu.tsx | `ActionAutoTrigger` → `useAutoTriggerOnce(action, …)` (not a grep hit) | reads the guarded member |
| auto-trigger.ts | refusal notice and toast id `action.name ?? action.label`, `action.label \|\| action.name` (three hits) | not edited: it reads the subject its caller hands it, and all four callers now hand a guarded one |
| static-params.ts | `String(subject.name ?? subject.label ?? '(unnamed)')` (not a grep hit) | guarded (scope note 7163349912) |

## Tests

The pins live in the existing harness files, each as its own top-level `describe` naming objectstack#37266 (AGENTS.md, ruling record 6583487846). Each mounts the node through the real `SchemaRenderer` and `ActionProvider`:

- `__tests__/action-group-menu-inputs-11168.test.tsx`, `describe('action:group — a non-string label renders no text and never throws (objectstack#37266)')`: inline (member button has no text and runs with no label, one warning) and dropdown (trigger shows `Actions`, member shows `approve`). CONTROL: string labels in both modes.
- same file, `describe('action:menu — a non-string label renders no text and never throws (objectstack#37266)')`: a locale-map label on the menu and on a member. No throw, the trigger keeps `More actions` and has no text, the item shows `approve`, no `[object Object]` and neither locale string in the text, the runner gets no label, and there is one warning per component (menu and member). CONTROL: string labels render and reach the runner.
- `__tests__/action-icon-autotrigger.test.tsx`, `describe('action:icon — a non-string label renders no text and never throws (objectstack#37266)')`: no `icon` (shows `?`, named `approve`, runs with no label, one warning), with `icon` (`aria-label` is `approve`), and a nameless action with node-level object `params` (the static-params warning names `(unnamed)` and no warning carries `[object Object]`). CONTROL: a string label is the initial, the accessible name and the runner label.

Fitting the harnesses: the group and menu pins use that file's own `mount` (which adds `SchemaRendererProvider` and `PredicateScopeProvider` around the node), `openMenu` and `run`; their `console.warn` spy is set up inside each `describe`. The icon file drives `action:icon` as an `action:bar` member with an `api` handler, so the icon `describe` keeps its own `run` handler, `SchemaRenderer` mount, `console.warn` spy and static-params reset inside the `describe`. The file gained the imports for those. No assertion changed (50 `expect(` calls before and after).

## Acceptance notes

- The menu and group pins assert text and accessible names, not `innerHTML`. Both renderers spread the host's undeclared node keys onto the DOM, so `actions="[object Object]"` is an attribute on any menu or inline group on main, and a raw `label` attribute rides along. That is an attribute leak, not a label read, and it is not user-visible text. It is out of this guard's reach and not filed.
- A nameless action with a locale-map label and node-level object `params` now gets two development warnings: the non-string-label warning (keyed `(unnamed)` for that renderer type) and the existing params warning. Both are dev-only.
- An `action:icon` with a non-string label and no `icon` shows `?`, the renderer's existing no-label fallback.
- As on `action:button`, a numeric label is now dropped with the same warning; the contract (`z.string()`) already refuses it.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-group-menu-inputs-11168.test.tsx packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-icon-autotrigger.test.tsx -t "objectstack#37266"`. Expected: 9 tests passed, the rest skipped.

<details><summary>Ablation (shared guard reverted, head 97ac493b9)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the guard's string check in `renderable-label.ts` (`if (label == null || typeof label === 'string') return label ?? undefined;`) with `return label as string | undefined;`, then ran the two harness files. The anchor went from 1 hit to 0 and the blob from 0e979351f9ca to fa737ebae282. Result: 2 files failed, 6 tests failed and 37 passed. The 6 failures are the six non-CONTROL label pins; the 37 that passed are the three CONTROLs and every existing test in the two files. The menu test rendered the error boundary's `Retry` instead of the menu (the throw). Three icon tests failed with `TypeError: schema.label?.charAt is not a function`. The group tests failed on text content and the runner call. After the restore, the blob equals HEAD (0e979351f9ca) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites and gates (head 97ac493b9)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check && pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/action/`: type-check clean, 37 files and 628 tests passed (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- After the pin move: `pnpm check:test-source-alias`, `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `pnpm check:nul-bytes` each exited 0.
- Round 1 (heads 49122c0b0 to 546ca7dbb): `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 38 families, all 38 were run and each exit code was captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation gave 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, and every recorded exit was 0. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` first exited 3, a prerequisite refusal whose cause the loop did not keep, and exited 0 on a standalone re-run. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 172 files passed and 2 skipped; 5130 tests passed.
- NOT MEASURED locally: the full `packages/components` suite and the CI-only lanes (Lint UI, Test UI shards, Build & E2E UI); CI runs them.
</details>
